title: North African-Style Brown Rice Paella
description: A flavorful and nutritious twist on traditional paella, made with brown rice and infused with the bold spices of North Africa.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped tomato and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the brown rice, moroccan spice blend, and vegetable broth to the pan.
Stir to combine and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve.
